description: Source code for the mfd_ad5592 driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing SPI communication and device initialization for the AD5592 device.

methods.name: mfd_ad5592_read_raw
methods.description: Reads raw data from the AD5592 device via SPI.

methods.name: mfd_ad5592_write_raw
methods.description: Writes raw data to the AD5592 device via SPI.

methods.name: mfd_ad5592_read_reg
methods.description: Reads a register value from the AD5592 device.

methods.name: mfd_ad5592_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a value to a register on the AD5592 device.

methods.name: mfd_add592_software_reset
methods.description: Performs a software reset on the AD5592 device.

methods.name: mfd_ad5592_init
methods.description: Initializes the AD5592 device, configuring GPIO and performing reset.
